source: historical Steer campaign main1000_w050; not R06 prospective data

support.matching: Distinct immediate parents, common grandparent, nearest online score, no pair reuse; equal families and batches

branch_direction_support.unit: One exact-copy family per geometric contrast; observed family-mean final affinity conditioned on common grandparent and similar online score
branch_direction_support.sparsity: Only 101 of 1169 teacher records qualified; the other records had zero confidence/direction support. Qualified amplitudes and confidence were small.

geometry_evidence.interpretation: No corrected-significant matched geometry feature. The lowest uncorrected p was 0.0383 for region_16_receptor_contact5, but its corrected q was 0.9753; it does not support a fixed motif or contact direction.

limitations.selection: Conditional spatial fields are direction-only: teacher point selection and priors remain frozen to the family_mean_v2 reference.
limitations.outcomes: Retrospective Steer-conditioned survivor branches; extinct futures are unknown, and repeated descendants/events are not independent replicates.
limitations.proxies: Occupancy/contact measures are geometric proxies, not binding energies or hydrogen-bond evidence. Temporal fit derivatives are not spatial forces.
limitations.efficacy: These support calculations do not establish prospective affinity benefit; R06 paired batch results were mixed, so no efficacy claim is made.
